The Majority Standard Bible — translated from this same Greek text — renders it “carefully” in 2 of those places (29%), e.g. Matthew 2:8; Luke 1:3. This is observed translation data, not an editorial opinion.
The Berean Standard Bible, an independent translation, agrees with that rendering in 100% of the same verses.
The sense “carefully” is independently listed by Dodson, corroborating the corpus evidence.

Text-critical note: it occurs 5 times in the critical text (SBLGNT) vs 9 in the Byzantine text — some occurrences sit in disputed passages.
Moulton–Milligan documents this word in everyday papyri and inscriptions, anchoring the meaning in ordinary Koine usage outside the New Testament.
